title: pelargonium betonicum
intro: Pelargonium betonicum, commonly known as "Red Form", is a species of flowering plant in the geranium family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Pelargonium betonicum include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, making it a popular herbal remedy for colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
